cohort: 342 neonates (114 born to mothers with COVID-19 during pregnancy and 228 born to mothers without COVID-19 during pregnancy)
finding: Maternal COVID-19 infection during pregnancy was associated with higher rates of cesarean sections and small for gestational age newborns, as well as lower mean birth weight.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were significantly higher among neonates born to mothers with COVID-19 compared to those without COVID-19 (71.1% vs. 43.4%, p < 0.001).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight reported for both groups (cases: 3.0 ± 0.6 kg, controls: 3.3 ± 0.6 kg)
